sections.title: Describe your home
sections.content: Combine *hay*, *estar*, articles and room vocabulary to show someone around a home.

items.spanish: Hay una cocina. La cocina está al lado de la sala.
items.english: There is a kitchen. The kitchen is next to the living room.

items.spanish: Hay dos habitaciones. Las habitaciones están arriba.
items.english: There are two bedrooms. The bedrooms are upstairs.

items.spanish: Aquí hay un baño. El baño está cerca de la cocina.
items.english: There is a bathroom here. The bathroom is near the kitchen.

sections.content: Start with *hay* when you introduce a room or object. Then use *estar* when you continue by saying where that specific thing is.
